alignment.empty_shadow_policy: aligned to the true-threat reveal from the same scene and controller
alignment.event: semantic-LiDAR reveal in the matched true-threat arm

bootstrap.purpose: descriptive uncertainty interval; no p-values are produced

clearance_definition: signed minimum separation between ego and neighboring oriented boxes; zero denotes contact and negative values denote overlap

ADA.definition: IDEAM minus candidate episode-mean ego speed

APF.definition: IDEAM minus candidate episode-mean ego speed

DREAM.definition: IDEAM minus candidate episode-mean ego speed

IDEAM.definition: IDEAM minus candidate episode-mean ego speed

section_4_4_metric_definitions.ego_maximum_speed_loss_mps: Maximum ego speed loss within the episode (m/s).
section_4_4_metric_definitions.maximum_follower_speed_loss_mps: Largest speed loss among the designated following vehicles in the episode (m/s).
section_4_4_metric_definitions.minimum_clearance_first_3s_after_referen: Minimum signed oriented-box clearance to any neighbor in the first 3 s after the matched semantic-LiDAR reveal reference (m).
section_4_4_metric_definitions.minimum_hidden_oriented_clearance_m: Episode minimum signed oriented-box clearance to the hidden vehicle (m).
section_4_4_metric_definitions.minimum_hidden_ttc_2d_s: Episode minimum constant-velocity, oriented-box two-dimensional TTC to the hidden vehicle (s).
section_4_4_metric_definitions.planner_reveal_to_hidden_aware_plan_appl: Delay from semantic-LiDAR reveal to the first applied hidden-aware plan (s).
section_4_4_metric_definitions.traffic_hard_braking_actor_count: Number of surrounding traffic actors meeting the hard-braking criterion.
section_4_4_metric_definitions.traffic_total_integrated_speed_deficit_v: Sum of surrounding-traffic integrated desired-speed deficits (vehicle-m).
